notes.title: Improved Demo
notes.notes:
Some more updates to the demo, including a bunch of bug fixes, improvements and quality of life updates.

Most importantly, as requested by BoomShoot Ken, you can now pee in the toilets and urinals.

notes.title: Improved Controls
notes.notes:
Just another note on some updates, this time regarding the controls.

The default keyboard mappings have changed, I've ditched the default equip next/prev keyboard mappings, while at the same time improving the mouse wheel weapon toggling.

A new addition is the ability to change weapons using the 0-9 number keys. For example, pistols are mapped to 2, Shotties mapped to 3, etc. If you have multiple of the same category (eg multiple different pistols) you can toggle between them with repeated presses of that that number key.

These can still be customized in the Control settings screen if you prefer something else.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Man how time flies... 2024 somehow came and went and I didn't post anything since March. Whoopsie daisies.

That's going to change in 2025, starting with this update.

A new and improved demo has just been released. Please, don't forget to smash that wishlist button while you are there, it means a lot!

This update includes a [i]ton[/i] of bug fixes and improvements as well as 2 more story levels and 4 more deathmatch levels. Included are new weapons, new characters and new enemies to blast.

Call Of Dookie will be listed in the Steam Couch Co-Op Fest running Feb. 10th - 17th, so why not grab some buddies and play a little bit of split-screen deathmatch just like your grandpappy used to play?!?!

The plan for the full v1 release of Call Of Dookie is late 2025.
